root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooPostalAreaMapTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooPostalAreaMapTbl ( MapID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooPostalAreaMapTbl PRIMARY KEY, PostalFrom INT NOT NULL, PostalTo INT NOT NULL, SuburbMatch NVARCHAR(100) NULL, AreaID INT NOT NULL, Priority INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooPostalArea_Priority DEFAULT (100), Source NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooPostalArea_Source DEFAULT (N'Manual'), IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooPostalArea_Active DEFAULT (1), Notes NVARCHAR(255) NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); CREATE INDEX IX_WooPostalArea_Range ON dbo.WooPostalAreaMapTbl (PostalFrom, PostalTo, IsActive); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAreaDeliveryDefaultTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooAreaDeliveryDefaultTbl ( AreaID INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooAreaDeliveryDefaultTbl PRIMARY KEY, DefaultPreferredAgentID INT NULL, PostalRanges NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooAreaDeliveryDefaultTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooAreaDeliveryDefaultTbl', N'PostalRanges') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooAreaDeliveryDefaultTbl ADD PostalRanges NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooShippingMethodMapTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooShippingMethodMapTbl ( MapID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooShippingMethodMapTbl PRIMARY KEY, MethodMatch NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, ToBeDeliveredByID INT NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooShipMethod_Active DEFAULT (1), Notes NVARCHAR(255) NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'DefaultImportAreaID') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ADD DefaultImportAreaID INT NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooPaymentMethodMapTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.WooPaymentMethodMapTbl ( MapID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_WooPaymentMethodMapTbl PRIMARY KEY, MethodMatch NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, PaymentAbbrev NVARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, IsActive BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_WooPayMethod_Active DEFAULT (1), Notes NVARCHAR(255) NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NULL, UpdatedBy NVARCHAR(100) NULL ); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl', N'ImportConflicts') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooOrderInfoTbl ADD ImportConflicts NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooPaymentMethodMapTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.WooPaymentMethodMapTbl) BEGIN INSERT INTO dbo.WooPaymentMethodMapTbl (MethodMatch, PaymentAbbrev, IsActive, Notes, UpdatedAt, UpdatedBy) VALUES (N'payfast', N'PF', 1, N'Default seed', SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'), (N'yoco', N'Yoco', 1, N'Default seed', SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'), (N'snapscan', N'SS', 1, N'Default seed', SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'), (N'bacs', N'EFT', 1, N'Direct bank / EFT', SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'), (N'eft', N'EFT', 1, N'Direct bank / EFT', SYSUTCDATETIME(), N'seed'); END
